svg.aria-label: An executable's functions, with the C runtime, the C++ library, zlib, middleware and compiler helpers labelled first. The functions left unlabelled are the game and its engine
svg.title: An executable's functions, with the C runtime, the C++ library, zlib, middleware and compiler helpers labelled first. The functions left unlabelled are the game and its engine
svg.text: Ghidra cannot tell the game's functions from a library's. Once the libraries are labelled, the rest is the game and its engine.
what is left, the game and its engine
Function signatures, copyright strings and constant tables (zlib's CRC table 0x77073096) find most of them.
